title: 3DBAG Semantic Attribute Specification Schema
description: Schema for resources/semantic/attributes.json, the format-independent semantic model of 3DBAG attributes. Format-specific locations, physical types, and serialization live in resources/projections/, not here. Pinned review decisions: valueFormat is optional and descriptive only (strftime for date/datetime, free-form otherwise; never validated against data values); precision is max decimal places (0-17), rounded half-to-even in float64 before narrowing to a physical type, and must be absent for non-float types (enforced by the validator, not expressible in draft-07); array items reuse the value definition (attribute = value + source + items), the item-only "null" type is dropped in favor of item-level nullable; required fields are type, description, semanticType, source, nullable; empty attribute names are rejected via propertyNames.

scalar-type.description: Logical value type of a scalar.

semanticType.description: What is the attribute? A year, a day, a millisecond, an error etc.

nullable.description: Whether null values are valid for this attribute or they indicate an error in the process.

precision.description: Maximum number of digits after the decimal point (decimal places, not significant digits). Round half-to-even in float64 first, then narrow to the physical type declared by the projection. Only valid for type float; must be absent otherwise.

scale.description: How is the attribute measured? On an interval scale, on a nominal scale etc.

valueFormat.description: Optional pattern describing the logical value. strftime pattern for date/datetime (e.g. 'YYYY-MM-DD'); free-form pattern otherwise (e.g. 'NL.IMBAG.Pand.<16 digits>', 'YYYY' for a year stored as int). Descriptive only: not validated against data values, and serializers may rely on it only for temporal types.

type.description: How is the attribute stored? As an int, as a float etc. 'array' requires 'items'.

semanticType.description: What is the attribute? A year, a day, a millisecond, an error etc.

source.description: The source of this attribute. It can be another data set like the BAG or a software that generates this attribute.

nullable.description: Whether null values are valid for this attribute or they indicate an error in the process.

precision.description: Maximum number of digits after the decimal point (decimal places, not significant digits). Round half-to-even in float64 first, then narrow to the physical type declared by the projection. Only valid for type float; must be absent otherwise.

scale.description: How is the attribute measured? On an interval scale, on a nominal scale etc.

valueFormat.description: Optional pattern describing the logical value. strftime pattern for date/datetime (e.g. 'YYYY-MM-DD'); free-form pattern otherwise (e.g. 'NL.IMBAG.Pand.<16 digits>', 'YYYY' for a year stored as int). Descriptive only: not validated against data values, and serializers may rely on it only for temporal types. Originallybouwjaar is intentionally int + 'YYYY' because source data contains invalid years (e.g. 9999) that must be preserved, not parsed as dates.

items.description: Definition of the items of an array-type attribute. Required when type is 'array'; must be absent otherwise (enforced by the validator). Items cannot themselves be arrays.
